reason: I'd take the free listing, sure, but I won't pay 59 lari a month plus a payment fee on top for QR bills my waiters will fight me on. My regulars already pay at the counter or the terminal, and I already reach them on Instagram for free every Thursday.
objection: My waiters will think the QR bill eats their tips, and I'd be paying a per-transaction fee on top of the terminal fee I already pay, on margins this thin.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a café my size in Tbilisi that tips stayed the same or went up and the loyalty offers brought back enough regulars to cover the 59 lari and the fees in the first month.
